name: GitHub
description: Manage GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and Actions in Cindy. When you open a PR, an interactive card helps you submit it and automatically follows CI and reviews until merge. Uses the local GitHub login. Supports github.com.
whenToUse: Use for github.com repositories and links; use GitLab for GitLab instances. Handles issues, PRs, reviews, merges, repositories, Actions, releases, search, and logs. Use the PR card to ask about opening a PR and to show its status afterwards. Uses the local GitHub login or a fallback token.

list_tools.description: List this plugin's 117 GitHub operations across issues, pulls, repo, commits, actions, releases, search, users, orgs, events, notifications, gists, git_data, reactions, and meta. With no category, return category names, counts, and descriptions; with a category, return every operation in that category with its description and parameters.

call_tool.description: Run a GitHub operation returned by list_tools, passing args according to its parameter schema. Repository operations require explicit owner and repo values, which may be derived from git remote get-url origin when working in a repository. API-link fields are removed by default except html_url; set raw=true for the original JSON. Results over 50KB are written to the session work directory and only the file path is returned; out_file can set the path. Downloads such as Actions artifacts or log ZIPs require a destination directory in the top-level save_dir field of ghost_call.

pr_card.description: Show a PR card. Before publication use repo/head/base; afterward pass pr/card_id and published=true only if this task just created it. Viewing an existing PR never starts follow-up. following=false respects publish-only/stop. With follow_state, the card owns scheduling: do not create another task/schedule; failed/unverified needs read-back. Legacy todo applies only without follow_state; claim_follow requires follow_claimed=true before scheduling. existing_task navigates to the owner. renamed/following report verified actions. Refresh by card_id; to_latest when notifying. ci_retry_repush is default-off, local to this plugin user across PRs. Read pr_follow_settings each round and before amend/push; missing/unreadable forbids rewrites. Only the pr Skill permits exclusive-branch SHA rewrite and leased repush: one attempt per diagnosed failure, two total per PR, then stop/report; never merge permission.

pr_follow_settings.description: Read the same auto-rename, auto-follow and follow-model preferences used by PR cards. Returns settings without showing a card, creating a task or starting follow-up; preferences are not proof that following is active. Use after opening a PR in IM too, then create and verify follow-up with the pr workflow. A read failure means unknown, not disabled. Returns ci_retry_repush: default-off, shared by this plugin user’s PR follow-ups on this computer only. When enabled, the pr Skill may rewrite an exclusive branch commit SHA and repush under its strict conditions, at most once per diagnosed failure and at most two total attempts per PR; stop and report at the limit; no merge authorization. Re-read each round and before amend/push; failed or missing settings forbid rewriting.
